Scaffold apps/server (Hono), RunStore, SSE/REST run APIs, monorepo scripts
Implement WorkflowCompiler + node handlers (input/output/agent/condition/memory); clear fail for tool/approval
/runs/[runId] page: Timeline + payload inspector + SSE reconnect UX
Read-only runtime graph synced from RunEvents; Run button on editor toolbar
Compiler/adapter/integration tests; roadmap progress + architecture note
